svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The LLM talks. The EHR service decides every booking.
Booking rules in code + clinic config
1. The patient speaks. 2. Speech becomes text. 3. The LLM picks a tool. 4. The EHR service checks the rules,
saves the booking and logs it. 5. The agent answers out loud and the dashboard updates within 2 seconds.
